entries.exactprompt: Scientific-educational anatomical exercise illustration. Reference is STYLE/COLORS ONLY. CHANGE VIEW completely to clean DIRECT SIDE PROFILE facing right, not rear three-quarter. Same grayscale male, opaque black shorts, same red quadriceps and orange posterior legs/lower back roles visible as applicable. Step-up onto plain rectangular low GRAY SOLID BOX with NO perspective distortion. In BOTH panels, identical box side rectangle at local x55%-85%, top y78%, bottom y90%; its exact position and dimensions never change. A human of constant standing height64% of panel. Panel1: front/RIGHT foot entirely on box top at x65%,y78%, thigh raised and knee naturally bent; LEFT leg behind supports foot on floor x40%,y90%. Head y24%. Panel2: stand tall on box with BOTH feet on top, head y14%, RIGHT foot remains x65%,y78%. Center of mass visibly rises, SAME skull/torso/femur/tibia dimensions throughout; legs cannot shrink. Orthographic camera remains static. The second pose must simply straighten the leg planted on the box while raising the floor foot. Full body inside panel with plenty of whitespace at top. Both feet anatomically connected, hands relaxed at sides. Avoid changing viewpoint, changing box length or location, auto-centering frames, bent/wobbling box, clipping.
entries.beforefinding: Platform moved/resized and human shortened on ascent.
entries.afterreview: Selected direct side view with simple solid low box. Head-to-floor span in first pose and head-to-platform span in second are visually consistent (~648 vs652 displayed px); head rises ~100px against ~90px box height. Box remains visually stable, small <5% panel-width raster drift. Leading foot remains on box; natural visible hip/knee extension, no extra limbs or clipping.

entries.exactprompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Edit attached two-frame calf-raise anatomy illustration. entries.exactprompt: Use case: scientific-educational. TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side, exact aspect ratio2:1. White background, opaque black shorts, no text/no arrow/no border, all limbs/head visible with margin. CRITICAL fixed orthographic side-three-quarter camera with identical person size. In EACH square, rear SUPPORT FOOT toes occupy local x30%, y90% and stay FIXED there. LEFT: upright standing, hands on hips, feet together near x30%; leave empty white space to his right for the future step. RIGHT: he steps ONLY the leading foot forward to x72%, y90%, torso translates forward, bends both knees to lunge. Rear foot toes REMAIN local x30%, y90%; rear heel lifts, rear knee bends toward floor. This means the standing figure MUST sit LEFT OF CENTER in left panel, and lunge spreads across right panel. DO NOT independently center both bodies. Same skeleton lengths/head size, consistent floor, front foot flat, front knee over ankle, torso upright. No extra limbs, no joint disconnection, no barbell. entries.afterreview: Standing figure intentionally left-biased and pelvis moves forward into lunge. Rear toe horizontal registration now within roughly3-4% panel width; slight depth/y difference remains. Front foot advances, two knees bend, hands remain on hips, proportions coherent, no clipping. No longer gross backward/forward split of two feet.
